Done. The narrow review of **2f-door-c000-c006-junction** is complete and delivered as **candidate_01**.

## What was found

**The previous calibration was wrong, and both endpoints moved.** Recalibrating from the original 2f plan's labeled dimension chains (green extension lines located by pixel profiles, not candidate geometry):
- **X**: top 25000 mm chain → px 241=0.000, 470=5.000, 697=9.940, 748=11.060, 929=15.000, 1387=25.000 m (~45.8 px/m, vs the old 44.25)
- **Y**: left 20000 mm chain → px 341=20.000 m (top edge), px 522=16.060 m (=20000−3940 line, exactly the door's host wall line) (~45.9 px/m)

**Endpoint evidence (physical reference named):** the west jamb is the **hinge side of the drawn cyan door leaf** (px 704–706), and the east jamb is where the **swing arc returns to the wall** beside the wall-return stub (px 740–742). This is distinctly *not* the wall-face ink gap, which is longer: the north-face ink run ends at the c002/c006 party wall (px ~694, west of the hinge) and the south-face run resumes at px ~750 (east of the arc return).

**Applied change (claim_0001, adopted, applied):** p1 x 9.9518 → **10.1157 m**, p2 x 10.8784 → **10.9173 m** (±0.033 m per endpoint; clear width ≈0.80 m). Identity, kind, both hosts (2f-c000 ↔ 2f-c006), host plane y=16.0646 and assumed z=[3.6, 5.7] unchanged; no other room, wall or opening touched; no wall moved. The west jamb moved ~0.16 m — the old value sat on the party-wall line, not the actual hinge jamb.

**Verification:** overlay on 2f_view.png with the independent labeled anchors projects the door exactly at px 705.0→741.5, on the drawn leaf/arc. Partial door review submitted (only this aperture matched; all other 2f doors remain explicitly unreviewed). Obsolete endpoint/calibration note replaced in the saved source.

## Limitations (retained/recorded)
- Door height is still assumed 2.1 m (no height dimension on the plan); swing state unknown; all building heights unlinked to image observations.
- ±1.5 px (~0.033 m) jamb reading uncertainty; x-scale from the local 1120 mm segment (45.54 px/m) vs whole-chain 45.84 px/m differs ≤5 mm (the overlay tool flags this cross-axis residual; door endpoints use the x scale only).
- The inherited prior-run claims (old jamb readings and 44.25/43.07 px/m calibration) remain marked "inherited / not rechecked" — they are read-only in this run (retraction attempt failed on file access), so I did not risk an id-based retraction of the old "claim_0001" (id collision with the new claim); their supersession is recorded in the replaced note and audit history.
- Whole-building fidelity, other openings, and room roles remain unverified; 1f side of this junction not examined.
